What a quiet morning teaches about shipping

October 21 · 6 min read

Most weeks I plan too much. This week I planned one thing, a small tool for the team, and the rest of the time went to answering questions that nobody had asked yet.

Start with the smallest useful thing

The first version did one job. It took a list of tasks and put them in a sensible order. It was ugly, and it was the first thing we used every day.

Get the next essay by email

Let people use it before it is ready

Feedback on a rough tool is honest. Feedback on a polished one is polite. I would rather have the honest kind, so the tool went out on day two.
